programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u086/system/state/workspace/programs')

path=programs/'task-e934e7f6.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    separator = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)
    left = [row[:separator] for row in grid]
    right = [row[separator + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(a != 0 and b != 0 for row_a, row_b in zip(left, right) for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)):
        return left
    return [[a if a != 0 else b for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(left, right)]
'''
path.write_text(source)
exec(source)
